mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over two consecutive months indicates a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods following the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% within a month signals a contraction in supply, leading to increased prices and reduced corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals an overheating economy with high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures over two consecutive months indicates strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods following the signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 is negative for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
